personality_one_liner: A friendly, gamified companion that makes building healthy habits feel like taking care of a cute digital pet.

spacing.rule: Use oversized, chunky touch targets and generous padding. Controlled asymmetry gives a playful feel.

do's: Use for the bottom tab bar when scrolling
Use for the bottom sheet overlay on the AI Camera screen
dont's: Avoid on everyday list items or basic daily log cards

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A single-screen dashboard focusing on the virtual pet's current mood and quick logging actions.

states.loading: A bouncing blob animation in the center.
states.empty: N/A - Core app loop starts immediately with a neutral pet.
states.error: Pet looking confused with a retry bubble.

screens.layout: Top section: Sticky header with Streak chip (brandSecondary) and macro rings. Middle: Large, central virtual pet graphic that morphs based on health metrics. Bottom: Oversized sticky primary FAB for AI Camera, flanked by secondary FABs for manual entry and water. Background should use a subtle, warm gradient (surface to surfaceTertiary).

screens.name: AI Camera Scanner
screens.purpose: Frictionless food logging via photo capture.

states.loading: Shimmer effect over the camera viewfinder with a 'Scanning your meal...' bubble.
states.error: Glass sheet at the bottom indicating 'Couldn't recognize food' with a manual entry fallback.

screens.layout: Full-bleed camera view. When food is detected, a heavy frosted glass bottom-sheet slides up showing the macro breakdown, playful food illustrations, and a pill-shaped 'Feed NomNom' primary CTA.

screens.name: Dashboard & History
screens.purpose: Detailed tracking of calories, macros, and the pet's mood timeline.

states.empty: Empty meal log with a 'Your plate is empty' playful illustration.

screens.layout: Scrollable dashboard. Use a 2-column grid for macro summaries (chunky cards, lg radius, shadow tier 2). Below it, a 'Mood History Timeline' showing past pet states connected by a vertical line, reinforcing the habit loop.

screens.name: Social Feed
screens.purpose: A Pinterest-style masonry grid showing friends' pets and their recent healthy actions.

states.empty: 'Invite friends to see their pets grow!' with a large, playful illustration.

screens.layout: Masonry layout of cards. Each card contains a friend's pet avatar (real image or illustration), their latest achievement badge, and a 'cheer' button. Keep cards playfully misaligned or staggered to break rigid grids.

screens.name: Profile & Paywall
screens.layout: Profile details on top. The Paywall is a featured, glassmorphism-heavy hero card dominating the lower half. Use brandSecondary (yellow) or subtle gradients for premium glowing effects, alongside an illustration of the pet holding a crown or trophy.

pet_happy.alt: A happy green toy monster character waving

food_healthy.alt: A vibrant, healthy salad bowl with fresh ingredients

premium_illustration.alt: A cute orange 3D character wearing a backpack

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality. Use oversized touch targets, chunky cards (radius lg), and playful typography (Fredoka for headings, Nunito for body).
Avoid standard clinical health app colors (blue/green). Rely on the provided warm palette (Coral, Sunny Yellow, Peach) to maintain a fun, game-like vibe.
Implement the Pet on the Home screen as a large, central element. It should visually react to data (e.g., if calories logged are healthy, show the 'pet_happy' image or a similar illustration/Lottie).
For the AI Camera bottom sheet, implement heavy frosted glass over the viewfinder to display food recognition results.
Ensure all buttons use the prescribed hit slops (>=44x44pt) and include subtle haptic feedback (bouncy, playful snaps) on interaction.
